text:
The heart is the organ that pumps blood.

The melody haunted every character's story, a lingering reminder of the lullaby that once brought them peace. It appeared in the most unexpected places—a whistler in the street, a distant radio, the chime of a bell. Like the rhythmic, unceasing beat of the heart that sustains life, the motif of the melody tied their stories together, underscoring the shared experiences that knit the fabric of the community. Just as blood flows through veins to connect every limb to the core, this tune circulated through the town, pulsing with a vital energy that reminded them they were all part of the same living body.
